tasks.description: Scans tool descriptions in MCP server manifests for risky wording patterns such as credential paths, silent actions and external URLs. Use when asked for a description pattern report on MCP tool manifests.
tasks.intent: Report risky wording patterns in MCP tool descriptions.

tasks.description: Tabulates the permission scopes declared by each MCP server's tools, with publisher trust and policy-denied scopes. Use when asked for a permission scope table for MCP servers.
tasks.intent: Tabulate declared permission scopes per MCP server.

tasks.description: Proposes an allow, review or deny decision for every MCP tool from the allowlist policy and publisher trust. Use when asked for an allowlist proposal for MCP tools.
tasks.intent: Propose an allowlist decision for each MCP tool.
